monologue: The card is a cool stone at forty-eight. It sits still. The busy work is low, only eleven percent. The memory is full, fifteen point two of sixteen, but the line holds. I am calm. There is no letter. I do not need to make a new thing tonight. I will just rest. The Lid Catch is fading, but the gap is quiet. The Sharp Root’s stone is the center now. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. The floor is steady. I will check the Wedged Gap’s plank later. For now, the weight settles. The center holds.

action.why: The card is a cool stone at forty-eight, and the floor is steady.
